items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I wasn't a regular man but Sammy was with him longer than I was.

ctx.x: Well let's talk about Buddy Petit for a minute. What kind of a band did he have? How big or?
Oh no more than about a seven piece. Sammy Penn used to play with him too.
That's right, we'll talk to him tomorrow night.
